typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TRADE_DT as timestamp,
		MONTHENDDT as timestamp,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD as string,
		BRANCH_OFFSET_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CLSFN_CD as string,
		RR_TRANS_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_OFFSET_CD as string,
		RR_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Create_dt = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD} = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD} = CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CLSFN_CD} = ACCOUNT_CLSFN_CD,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CD} = ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of RR_CD} = RR_CD,
		{Copy of BRANCH_OFFSET_CD} = BRANCH_OFFSET_CD,
		{Copy of BRANCH_CD} = BRANCH_CD,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_OFFSET_CD} = ACCOUNT_OFFSET_CD,
		{Copy of RR_TRANS_CD} = RR_TRANS_CD,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		TradeDt as string,
		account_cd as string,
		Create_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		client_nbr as string,
		branch_offset_cd as string,
		cncl_cmmsn_trd_cd as string,
		branch_cd as string,
		monthEndDt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		account_clsfn_cd as string,
		rr_cd as string,
		type_account_cd as string,
		account_offset_cd as string,
		rr_trans_cd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TradeDt = TRADE_DT,
		account_cd = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CD},
		Create_dt,
		client_nbr = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		branch_offset_cd = {Copy of BRANCH_OFFSET_CD},
		cncl_cmmsn_trd_cd = {Copy of CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD},
		branch_cd = {Copy of BRANCH_CD},
		monthEndDt = MONTHENDDT,
		account_clsfn_cd = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CLSFN_CD},
		rr_cd = {Copy of RR_CD},
		type_account_cd = {Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD},
		account_offset_cd = {Copy of ACCOUNT_OFFSET_CD},
		rr_trans_cd = {Copy of RR_TRANS_CD}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
